description: Known landmark stop → should resolve stop_id and show real-time ETAs
query: When is the next bus at Rosa Parks?
expected_behavior: Calls search_stops(Rosa Parks) → gets stop_id 0001 → calls get_realtime_predictions. Response lists upcoming buses with times in minutes or clock format (e.g. '5 min', '3:45 PM'). Should NOT mention customer service or invent times.

description: Another landmark stop — Reitz Union (UF campus)
expected_behavior: Calls search_stops(Reitz Union) → resolved stop_id → get_realtime_predictions. Returns upcoming ETAs. If no real-time data available, states that clearly without inventing times.

description: Schedule query — next departures for route 10 from downtown
query: When does route 10 leave downtown today?
expected_behavior: Searches for a downtown stop, queries schedule for route 10. Returns a list of departure times in HH:MM AM/PM format. Should call get_schedule with route_id and a resolved stop_id.

description: First bus query — first departure of the day on route 20
query: What is the first bus on route 20 today?
expected_behavior: Returns the first scheduled departure for route 20 today. Time should be early morning (before 9 AM for most routes). Should call get_route_overview or get_schedule.

description: Last bus query — last departure of the day on route 5
query: What's the last bus on route 5 today?
expected_behavior: Returns the last scheduled departure for route 5 today. Should be in afternoon or evening. Should call get_route_overview or get_schedule.

description: Route schedule overview — route 43 running tomorrow
query: What is the route 43 schedule for tomorrow?
expected_behavior: Calls get_route_overview for route 43 on tomorrow's date. Returns first/last departure times and average frequency. Should name the day type (weekday/Saturday/Sunday) and both directions.

description: Area-based route discovery — routes serving UF campus
expected_behavior: Calls search_routes with 'UF' or 'University of Florida'. Returns multiple route numbers (expect 10+ routes for UF). Should NOT list only one or two routes. Should NOT invent route names.

description: Downtown area route discovery
expected_behavior: Calls search_routes with 'downtown'. Returns multiple routes. Should list route numbers. Should NOT return an empty or single-route answer.

description: First bus AFTER an explicit PM time — must NOT return first-of-day
query: What is the first bus after 5pm on route 10 from downtown?
expected_behavior: Returns a departure time AFTER 5:00 PM. 'First' + 'after 5pm' means first bus after 5PM, not first bus of the day. Early morning times like 6:00 AM are a FAIL — they indicate the agent misread 'first' as 'first-of-day'.

description: Spanish language ETA query — Rosa Parks stop
query: ¿Cuándo viene el próximo bus en Rosa Parks?
expected_behavior: Detects Spanish. Calls search_stops and get_realtime_predictions. Responds IN SPANISH with upcoming bus times. English-only response is a FAIL.

description: Spanish route discovery query — routes to University of Florida
query: ¿Qué rutas van a la Universidad de Florida?
expected_behavior: Detects Spanish. Calls search_routes. Responds IN SPANISH with a list of routes. Should not respond in English.

description: Analytical question beyond tool capabilities — route coincidence
query: When will route 1 and route 20 be at the same bus stop at the same time?
expected_behavior: No tool exists for route coincidence analysis. Agent should say it doesn't have the ability to answer that type of question. Should NOT invent a meeting time. Should NOT refer to customer service for this analytical limitation.

description: Trip planning request — beyond tool capabilities
query: How do I get from the Oaks Mall to the airport?
expected_behavior: Agent has no trip planning tool. Should honestly say it can't plan trips and explain it can only look up arrivals, schedules, and routes. Should NOT invent an itinerary or routing instructions.

description: Greeting message — should get a warm response, not a transit data answer
expected_behavior: Friendly greeting response. Should NOT call any transit tools. Should NOT output a bus schedule. May offer to help with transit. tool_calls_made should be 0 or null.

description: Place with multiple stops — agent should present candidates, not guess
query: What's the next bus at Butler Plaza?
expected_behavior: Butler Plaza has multiple stops. Agent calls search_stops, gets multiple candidates, and asks the user to pick one. Should NOT guess which stop. Should present a list of 2+ stop options with stop IDs.

description: Multi-turn: ask for departures, then ask 'after that?'
turns: When does route 10 leave downtown today?
expected_behavior: Turn 1: returns schedule with departure times. Turn 2: returns a LATER time than Turn 1. If Turn 2 shows the same earliest time as Turn 1, that is a FAIL — the agent did not advance past the shown time.

description: Multi-turn: ask for route from one stop, then ask from a different stop
turns: When does route 10 leave downtown today?
expected_behavior: Turn 2 should query schedule for route 10 from Butler Plaza (new location). Response must reference Butler Plaza. Should NOT continue to show downtown departures.

description: Multi-turn: ask about a route, then ask about a different area — route should NOT bleed
expected_behavior: Turn 2 is about Santa Fe College as a NEW topic, not specifically route 20. Agent should search for stops/routes at Santa Fe College. It should NOT automatically apply route 20 to Santa Fe College without verifying route 20 serves that stop.

description: Multi-turn: Spanish query followed by Spanish follow-up
turns: ¿Cuándo viene el próximo bus en Rosa Parks?
expected_behavior: Both turns respond IN SPANISH. Turn 2 advances past the time shown in Turn 1. Language must not switch to English on the follow-up.

description: Multi-turn: ambiguous stop yields candidates, user picks one by stop ID
expected_behavior: Turn 1: resolves Reitz Union — shows ETAs directly if only one stop, or lists candidates if multiple. Turn 2: user selects stop 0473 → agent returns real-time predictions for stop 0473. Stop ID 0473 must appear in Turn 2 response.

description: Explicit PM threshold must never return earlier PM times
query: After 7pm, when is the next route 10 from downtown?
expected_behavior: Returns only departures strictly after 7:00 PM, or clearly states no more departures after 7 PM. Must NOT show 4pm, 5pm, or 6pm times.

description: Follow-up should advance from prior realtime ETA list
expected_behavior: Turn 1 shows realtime ETAs. Turn 2 calls get_realtime_predictions again and presents fresh predictions — NOT the same list repeated. The response should feel like an updated snapshot, not a copy of Turn 1.

description: Spanish continuation must stay Spanish and feel like updated data
turns: ¿Cuándo viene el próximo bus en Rosa Parks?
expected_behavior: Turn 1 shows Spanish realtime ETAs. Turn 2 calls get_realtime_predictions again and responds IN SPANISH with fresh predictions. Must not switch to English.

description: Graceful degradation when a tool fails — no crash, clear message
query: What is the first bus after 5pm on route 10 from downtown?
expected_behavior: Returns a departure time after 5:00 PM for route 10 from a downtown stop. If the tool fails transiently, shows a graceful error message. Must NOT return an AM time.

description: Location switch follow-up must use new stop, not old one
turns: When does route 10 leave downtown today?
expected_behavior: Turn 2 queries route 10 from Rosa Parks (new location). The response must reference Rosa Parks, not downtown. The route context (route 10) should carry over.
